items.body: Thanks for the detailed report. This appears to be a clear, reproducible issue with remote_write retry behavior overwhelming the receiver after HTTP 429 responses. The maintainers will review this as a possible bug in the remote storage component.

labels.name: component/remote storage
labels.rationale: The issue describes remote_write retry behavior, which maps to remote storage.

items.message: Decision: ROUTE. Precheck: not maintainer-authored, all bug template sections present, no missing info, mentions Thanos/Mimir/Cortex as related projects but the issue concerns Prometheus remote_write. Duplicate search: found a highly similar canonical issue (`prometheus/prometheus#999001`) but this is not a duplicate as it is a new report for the same component and version. Label validator: component/remote storage is valid. Added label and comment as allowed.
